resolutionOverrides.reason: web-ext loads its Android device bridge only for `web-ext run --target=firefox-android`, which this repository never runs. The real package pulls in node-forge, and node-forge 1.4.0, its newest release, still carries the RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature-verification advisory, so no version pin can answer it. The local stand-in throws if anything ever asks for an Android target.
resolutionOverrides.recheckBecause: Drop the stand-in once node-forge ships a fixed release and adbkit takes it, or the day this repository needs web-ext on Firefox for Android.

resolutionOverrides.reason: Seven advisories in 2026, the most recent (2026-09-29) a quadratic-time rewrite that 5.0.9 still allowed, all reachable only through development tooling.
resolutionOverrides.recheckBecause: This package's history is a mitigation being bypassed rather than one fix holding, so a pin that looks current is not evidence that it is.

resolutionOverrides.reason: Transitive development dependency; 0.6.1 fixes destination-symlink traversal during archive extraction.

Eight advisories so far against fast-uri 3.x, all host confusion, scheme spoofing or path equivalence through URL normalisation; 3.1.9 fixes the four from October 2026. It reaches this tree only as web-ext -> addons-linter -> ajv, so nothing it parses is user input, but the pin costs nothing and npm reported a non-breaking fix. The 4.x line is a major bump ajv does not ask for.
resolutionOverrides.recheckBecause: Four separate normalisation bypasses shipped against the same parser inside one minor line, so 3.1.6 holding today is not evidence the class is closed.

resolutionOverrides.reason: Transitive development dependency; 4.3.2 bounds merge-key expansion work and fixes the CPU denial-of-service advisory.

Transitive development dependency through web-ext -> fx-runner. 1.11.0 fixes quote() emitting a command-injection-ready token after a { comment } token followed by a line terminator; 1.12.0 is the current release.
Transitive development dependency through web-ext -> addons-linter -> css-tree. 1.2.2 bounds indexed source-map section offsets, which could otherwise stall the event loop.
resolutionOverrides.answersAdvisory: source-map-js indexed section offset denial of service (>=1.0.0 <1.2.2)

resolutionOverrides.reason: Transitive development dependency through web-ext -> addons-linter -> cheerio. 7.30.1 stops an unhandled error on a response with too many content encodings from crashing the process.

addons-linter merges its own bundled WebExtension schemas through deepmerge, so no outside input reaches it here, but the advisory covers every 4.2.0 to 4.3.1 release and no fixed one exists. The stand-in is 4.3.1 with the write of an own __proto__ key removed.
resolutionOverrides.recheckBecause: Drop the stand-in as soon as deepmerge publishes a fixed release that addons-linter can take.

resolutionOverrides.reason: A glob with repeated **/.. grows its pattern set without bound at optimizationLevel 2 and up, and every release below 11.0.1 is affected. Globs here come from this repository and from web-ext, so it is reachable only through development tooling. eslint 10 and the eslint 9 inside addons-linter read only the Minimatch class and the named exports, which 11 keeps.
resolutionOverrides.recheckBecause: Drop the pin once eslint and addons-linter both declare a fixed minimatch range themselves.

resolutionOverrides.reason: web-ext pins multimatch 6.0.0, which default-imports minimatch, and minimatch 11 has no default export. Stock multimatch 8 loads, but it leaves minimatch reading the backslashes in web-ext's resolved Windows patterns as escapes, so the ignore list matched nothing on Windows and web-ext would have linted and packaged node_modules and .git. The stand-in is multimatch 8 with windowsPathsNoEscape on by default on Windows, which gave the same answer as 6.0.0 for every path tried.
resolutionOverrides.recheckBecause: Drop the stand-in with the minimatch pin, once web-ext moves past multimatch 6 and passes Windows patterns correctly itself.
